steps: Structured work-up: examination, bloods, imaging (CT) and targeted tissue diagnosis (excision/core biopsy).
Avoid empirical steroids before histology (can obscure lymphoma diagnosis).
Refer to the appropriate oncology/haematology MDT promptly.
Definitive treatment is tumour-specific after staging.
Manage symptoms and oncological emergencies (hypercalcaemia, SVCO, cord compression).

confirm: Constitutional 'B' symptoms (weight loss, fevers, night sweats) ± lymphadenopathy/organomegaly suggesting lymphoma/occult malignancy.
